chunks: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu'addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi narrated to us from Sulayman b. Abdullah al-Hashimi from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Mufaddal from Jabir al-Ju'fi. He said: I heard Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) say to Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him):

O Ali! You are my brother, my deputy, and my inheritor. You are my vicegerent over my Nation in my lifetime and after my passing. Whoever loves you loves me, and whoever hates you hates me. Your enemies are my enemies, and your friends are my friends.

key_terms.خليفة: Vicegerent, successor — one who governs on behalf of another
key_terms.وارث: Inheritor — heir to the Prophet's knowledge and authority
key_terms.وصي: Deputy, executor — the one entrusted with carrying out the Prophet's spiritual legacy

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say to Ali about being his brother, deputy, and vicegerent?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad, as reported through the companion Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari, addressed Ali b. Abi Talib directly, designating him as his brother, deputy (wasi), inheritor (warith), and vicegerent (khalifa) over the Muslim community both during his lifetime and after his death. He further established a complete identification between himself and Ali in terms of love, enmity, and friendship. This hadith, narrated in the Assembly of Ghadir Khumm (18th Dhul Hijja, 367 AH), encapsulates the core Shia doctrine of Ali's divine appointment as the Prophet's successor.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu’addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. `Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi narrated to us from Sulayman b. `Abdullah al-Hashimi from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Mufaddal from Jabir al-Ju`fi. He said: I heard Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say to `Ali b. Abi Talib (as):

O `Ali! You are my brother, my deputy, and my inheritor. You are my vicegerent over my Nation in my lifetime and after my passing. Those who love you love me, and those who hate you hate me. Your enemies are my enemies, and your friends are my friends.
